name: Al-Burāq
description: Al-Burāq is the celestial steed of Islamic tradition that, according to Hadith narrations, carried the Prophet Muhammad on the Isra and Mi'raj — the night journey from the Sacred Mosque in Mecca to the Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem and the subsequent ascent through the seven heavens.
origin: A single mythological figure of universal scope within Islamic tradition. The narrative geography of the night journey runs from Mecca (al-Masjid al-Haram) to Jerusalem (al-Masjid al-Aqsa) and through the seven heavens.
